en.headline: Prince of Wales patient dies after being given normal meal instead of pureed food
en.dek: A 54-year-old man with swallowing difficulties choked and suffered cardiac arrest after staff served a normal dinner; the hospital has apologised and stood down two staff.
body: Prince of Wales Hospital has reported a serious patient safety incident in which a 54-year-old man with cognitive impairment and swallowing difficulties died after being given a normal meal instead of the pureed diet he required.

The patient was admitted via the accident and emergency department on the morning of 16 September after his mental state deteriorated. He had no identity documents with him, so the hospital registered him under a temporary virtual identity number. A doctor ordered a diet as tolerated, but the hospital’s nutrition and meal management system defaults patients on virtual numbers to a normal meal. Nursing staff did not complete a check of his previous dietary records, and a normal dinner was served.

A patient care assistant began feeding him at about 6.40 pm. The patient soon showed distress. Staff stopped the feed, suctioned his airway and called specialist help. He suffered a cardiac arrest while obstruction was being cleared and died later that night.

Hospital records later confirmed that speech therapists had previously assessed him as needing a pureed diet because of swallowing impairment. The hospital said it was deeply saddened, had met the family to apologise and explain, and had temporarily reassigned the nurse and care assistant involved. A root-cause analysis committee will report within eight weeks and the case has been referred to the Coroner.

zh.headline: 威院病人需糊餐卻獲正常餐 哽喉後不治
zh.dek: 54歲認知障礙男病人入院後被餵正常晚餐，出現哽喉及心臟停頓，同日深夜離世；院方已向家屬致歉，兩名涉事員工暫時調離崗位。
body: 威爾斯親王醫院公布一宗醫療風險警示事件，一名患有認知障礙症、曾經中風及需要進食糊餐的54歲男病人，於9月16日上午因精神狀態轉差經救護車送院，其後在餵食期間出現哽喉及心臟停頓，同日深夜離世。
初步調查顯示，病人入院時未有攜帶身份證明文件，院方為其登記「虛擬身份號碼」。醫生按臨床情況指示護士安排「可耐受進食」，惟醫院營養及膳食管理系統會將虛擬身份號碼病人預設為正常餐，病房護士當時未完成檢視病人過往膳食紀錄以調整指示，故病人當晚獲分派正常晚餐。
病人服務助理約傍晚6時40分開始餵食後，發現病人不適，隨即停止餵食並通知護士。護士發現血含氧量下降，立即為病人吸痰及供氧，其後召喚耳鼻喉科及深切治療科醫生取出氣道阻塞物，期間病人一度心臟停頓，情況持續惡化，延至深夜離世。
院方事後檢視病史，確認病人過往因自身疾病經常住院，言語治療師評估後證實有吞嚥障礙，建議進食糊餐。院方對病人離世感到非常難過，已約見家屬解釋、致歉及致以深切慰問，涉事護士及病人服務助理已暫時調離臨床崗位。事件已通報醫管局總辦事處，院方成立根源分析委員會，八周內提交報告，個案已轉交死因裁判官跟進。
